## Slope

```{r}
#| label: setup-slope
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/slope/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data-loading-slope
#| include: false
slope <- tryCatch({
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_slope.csv")), col_types = "cd") %>%
    rename(Bin = 1, Count = 2) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Bin), Count > 0) %>%
    mutate(Slope = as.numeric(str_replace(Bin, "[-+].*", "")),
           percent = Count / sum(Count),
           Bin = factor(Bin, levels = Bin))
}, error = function(e) { message("slope not available: ", e$message); NULL })
```

```{r}
#| label: slope-donut
#| results: asis

if (is.null(slope) || nrow(slope) == 0) print_text(paste_bold("No Slope file available")) else {

  slope_names <- arrange(slope, Slope)$Bin
  slope_colors <- c(
    "#F9F9DF",
    "#E8D6B9",
    "#D5B495",
    "#BE9172",
    "#A86E50") %>%
    setNames(slope_names)

  slope_plot <- ggdonut(slope, "Bin", "percent", colors = slope_colors)
  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "wsf-slope-pieplot.png"), device = "png",
        width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(slope_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  print_paged_df(slope)
}
```
